name: Templeton World Charity Foundation — Planning Grant
institution: Templeton World Charity Foundation, in partnership with the Nagel Institute for the Study of World Christianity
summary: Planning grant for a research program on polarization and listening across communities, co-led with Dr. Damaris Parsitau. Extends the Bridging Beliefs and Behaviours modeling work to congregations in Brazil and Kenya, with ethnographic fieldwork preceding the computational modeling.

name: Calvin Research Fellowship
summary: Awarded 4 faculty load hours for the 2026–2027 academic year for the project "Modeling Political and Religious Polarization in Christian Communities." Named a Diekema Fellow, with support paid through the Diekema Endowment.

name: Nagel Institute Fellowship
institution: Nagel Institute for the Study of World Christianity — Calvin University
summary: Supporting research on computational modeling of world Christian communities.
